summary: REQ-2 appears implemented by updating ShareButton to copy window.location.origin + window.location.pathname and show success/error toasts. REQ-1 (actual publish/deploy to a live URL) is not evidenced in the diff. The diff also introduces new quote/lead backend functionality and admin leads page references, which are explicitly listed as non-goals (new quote/admin features).

missing_requirements.requirement: Publish/deploy the current latest build of the Foam Daddy Storefront so it is publicly accessible via a live URL.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff contains frontend runtime hardening (error boundary, SPA 404 fallback) and a deployment guide, but no actual deployment configuration/change that would produce a live/public URL (e.g., hosting config, CI/CD, canister deploy config, environment settings). A live URL itself cannot be verified from the code changes shown.
